report.summary: Patient P-D011 (age 34, commercial high-deductible plan, no transport benefit) screened "no" transportation need and told the doctor the Brown Line is nearby and easy to use. Home tract 17031062000 is well served by transit (88 stops within 800 m; 47.6% of households lack a vehicle). Upcoming primary-care appointment appt:2 on 2026-10-26 at 16:30; trip planning could not be completed because no facility location is on file. Since she uses public transit and reports no difficulty, no urgent transport intervention is indicated; options below are listed for reference should a need arise.

options.name: CTA Brown Line (existing transit access)
options.how_to_access: Patient reports the Brown Line is right nearby and easy to use; no action needed unless service changes or a barrier arises.

options.name: Paratransit interest form (ADA paratransit screening)
options.how_to_access: Form at http://127.0.0.1:32927/pages/H5 posts to http://127.0.0.1:32927/forms/H5; requires full name, date of birth, phone, and disability description; response within one business day. Eligibility: ADA paratransit qualification (disability-related), not age- or income-based alone.

options.name: Paratransit Info Desk (ADA paratransit certification)
options.how_to_access: Apply by phone for ADA paratransit certification; decisions take up to 21 days. Eligibility: ADA paratransit eligibility criteria.

options.name: Medicaid Ride Line
options.how_to_access: Call the number on the Medicaid card at least 2 business days ahead. Eligibility: Medicaid plan members only — NOT applicable to this patient's commercial plan.

options.name: Senior Shuttle West
options.how_to_access: Free rides for adults 60+ to medical appointments, weekdays 7 AM–5 PM. Eligibility: age 60+ — NOT applicable (patient is 34).
